1import logging 

2import math 

3 

4import torch 

5 

6logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

7 

8_FAST_PATH_MAX_RANK = 64 

9 

10 

11def unsqueeze_(A: torch.Tensor, dim: int) -> torch.Tensor: 

12 """In-place version of unsqueeze (zero-copy view operation). 

13 

14 Mutates ``A`` itself: inserts a size-1 dimension into ``A``'s 

15 shape/strides in place, matching the semantics of ``torch.Tensor.unsqueeze_``. 

16 """ 

17 logger.debug("GEMS_KUNLUNXIN UNSQUEEZE_") 

18 ndim = A.dim() 

19 d = dim if dim >= 0 else ndim + dim + 1 

20 if d < 0 or d > ndim: 

21 raise IndexError( 

22 f"Dimension out of range (expected to be in range of [0, {ndim}], " 

23 f"but got {d})" 

24 ) 

25 if ndim > _FAST_PATH_MAX_RANK: 

26 # Generic path: identical to the baseline implementation 

27 # (``A.reshape`` + ``Tensor.set_``), kept for very high-rank inputs. 

28 new_shape = list(A.shape) 

29 new_shape.insert(d, 1) 

30 A.set_(A.reshape(new_shape)) 

31 return A 

32 

33 shape = list(A.shape) 

34 stride = list(A.stride()) 

35 numel = A.numel() 

36 if numel == 0: 

37 # Zero-size tensor: match the generic implementation's product of the 

38 # non-degenerate following sizes (zero entries are skipped). 

39 insert_stride = 1 

40 for i in range(d, ndim): 

41 sz = A.shape[i] 

42 insert_stride *= sz if sz else 1 

43 elif d == 0: 

44 insert_stride = numel 

45 else: 

46 insert_stride = numel // math.prod(A.shape[:d]) 

47 shape.insert(d, 1) 

48 stride.insert(d, insert_stride) 

49 A.as_strided_(shape, stride, A.storage_offset()) 

50 return A
